blocks.text: Whether it's a family dinner, a gathering of friends, or a chat with loved ones, this Shintenchi four-piece sofa is a must for your outdoor life.Carefully selected Teslin fabrics and sturdy iron frames make this outdoor product cool on hot summer.When your friends visit, it's a great choice for friends and family to gathering with shintenchi patio set!Specification: Color: Gray, Black Dimension of Glass Table: 35.5 "x19.6" x 16.1 "Double Chair dimension of 38.5" X22.4 "x 30.4" Single Chairs Dimensions: 23.8 "x 22.4" x30.4 "Weight cover city : 350lbs package includes: 1x Table with Glass 1x Loveseat 2x Single Chairs

items.label: Comfortable Textile Material
items.value: The back and seat of the chair are made of textile materials with many meshes. It is one of the selected materials for outdoor furniture. This quality material is very breathable and you will enjoy it even in the summer. When it’s dirty, just wipe it with a wet or dry cloth.

items.label: Sturdy and Durable
items.value: The frame of the whole set is made of Powder-coated steel tubes. According to the principle of structural mechanics, the unique support structure of the set can provide stronger and stable support for you. This kind of steel tube is resistant to deformation and aging, for long service life. And the Powder-coated can reduce the erosion of the frame by rain.

items.label: Modern and Simplicity Design
items.value: The appearance of the 4 pieces patio furniture set is designed by a professional furniture team. The fashionable style and exquisite workmanship can suitable for patio, garden, porch, Lawn, living room, poolside. To prolong its service life, please put it under a cover in rainy days.

items.label: Easy to Install and Move
items.value: The installation method of the set is simple and direct, with the attached installation instructions. The curved back of the chair allows you to lift it up. With this design, you can move the set easily. Besides, it prevents you from leaving scratches on the floor when you move the chair.

items.label: Package Include
items.value: The set includes a glass table, a double chair and two single chairs. It will provide convenience and leisure. We trust you will enjoy it in all circumstances. In addition, cushions and throw pillows in the pictures are not included.
